Name: ✦ Heartwood
Description: <light_purple>Something old lives in the grain of it, and it is in no hurry at all.
- A <red><bold>Thorns</bold> <reset>wall that punishes every impatient swing
- A <red><bold>Life</bold> <reset>pool built for a long, patient watch

Notifications.20: <light_purple>It stops pretending to be still — Heartwood wakes for good.
Notifications.70: <light_purple>Turn your back on it, even once, and you'll regret it.
